trace.cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[r:PlaysFor]->(t:Team), (p)-[:MentionedIn]->(pd:Document), (t)-[:MentionedIn]->(td:Document) WHERE r.tenure = 'latest' AND CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) = 0 AND p.position <> 'Backcourt' AND CAST(t.founded_year AS INT64) <> 1989 RETURN t.team_name AS col1, AVG(CAST(p.fiba_world_cup AS DOUBLE)) AS col2
